runs.narrative: In the Nursery, a chilly and neglected chamber filled with trays of dry compost under cracked glass, I found myself wandering. The door to the north led to the Furnace, while the colonnade ran to the east. I picked up a trowel and twine that were lying on the floor, examining each object closely. The trowel seemed old and worn, while the twine was a ball, furred with age. I continued to explore the forgotten space, taking note of my surroundings and the items within.

My journey was one of discovery, as I read through the ledger, trying to uncover the secrets of the once grand home. Each room held relics of a time long past, reminding me of the passage of time and the inevitable decay of all things. As I made my way back through the estate, my prized possessions in hand, I was left questioning who had been here before me, what they had been doing, and why they left.
